description: This file defines a class 'UniqueAddOnIdChecker' that implements a checker for ensuring unique add-on IDs within a directory structure, along with utility functions for identifying add-on files and extracting add-on IDs from XML data.

classes.name: UniqueAddOnIdChecker
classes.description: A class that checks for duplicate add-on IDs in a directory structure, ensuring uniqueness across multiple XML files.

methods.name: isAddOnsFile
methods.description: Determines if a given filename corresponds to an add-on XML file based on predefined supported suffixes.

methods.name: getAddOnsFromXml
methods.description: Extracts add-on IDs from a parsed XML object based on supported add-on types.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Initiates the recursive check process starting from a root directory, verifying the uniqueness of add-on IDs.

methods.name: checkRec
methods.description: Recursively scans directories and XML files to collect add-on IDs and detect duplicates.
